sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.description:
Analyze the complete JSON output returned by the "Get Food Base Problem" tool.
Use the "food_base_problem_data" input from that tool output.
The input contains the fields: Number, Use Case, Problem Type, Student Count, Meal Type, Mess Hall, Description, and State.
Determine Priority using ONLY Use Case and Student Count.
This tool must be called only after Get Food Base Problem has successfully retrieved the record.
